d: Gold prices have rallied since the US midterm elections. This comes after oil prices and the value of the US dollar fell, following the Democratic party wresting control of the US Congress from the Republican party in the midterm elections. Firstpost looks at why US President Donald Trump's loss in the midterms has sparked a surge in gold prices. Hem Kaur Saroya explains the reasons behind investors pouring their money into gold and other precious metals like silver and platinum. HKS also looks at the impact the rising gold prices will have on Indian shoppers ahead of the Diwali holidays…
